nodes.text: TRANSLATION REPUBLIC OF PANAMA MINISTRY OF FOREIGN RELATIONS
nodes.why: round 3: title of the translated reply note = owner ∪ document type (NOTATIONS "The title"): the ministry letterhead #28 (owner; text keeps only the heading part, not the address line "Panama City 4, Panama") ∪ the TRANSLATION label #27 (what the document is); L1 for pp6-7. The US note pp1-5 prints no title (No. 543 = note number, DIPLOMATIC NOTE = stamp), so it has no node
